# ScriptBlockEntity

*Common*

ServerBlockEntity represents a block entity (tile entity) in the Minecraft world. Block entities are special blocks that can store additional data and perform updates, such as chests, furnaces, or custom modded blocks.

Block entities maintain their own state and can interact with the world around them. They are positioned at specific coordinates and can store custom data using NBT compounds.

## Methods

### getMinecraftTileEntity {#getminecrafttileentity}

::: member

**Returns** `BlockEntity` — the Minecraft block entity, for Java code

:::

### getServerWorld {#getserverworld}

::: member

For block entities of a server world.

**Returns** [`ScriptServerWorld`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerWorld) — the server world of the block entity

:::

### getClientWorld {#getclientworld}

::: member

For block entities of a client world.

**Returns** [`ScriptClientWorld`](/scripting/client/ScriptClientWorld) — the client world of the block entity

:::

### getType {#gettype}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — text of the Minecraft block entity type object, for debugging; use [`getId()`](#getid) for the ID

:::

### getPosition {#getposition}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector with the block position

:::

### markDirty {#markdirty}

::: member

Marks the block entity as changed, so its data is saved with the chunk; [`setNbtCompound`](#setnbtcompound) does it already.

:::

### getBlock {#getblock}

::: member

```js
var chest = c.getWorld().getBlockEntity(4, 64, 4);

if (chest != null) {
    c.send("Block: " + chest.getBlock().getId());
}
```

**Returns** [`ScriptBlock`](/scripting/common/block/ScriptBlock) — the block state of the block entity, as last seen by it

:::

### getNbtCompound {#getnbtcompound}

::: member

```js
var block = c.getWorld().getBlockEntity(3, 64, 3);

if (block != null && block.getNbtCompound().has("CustomName")) {
    c.send("Named block: " + block.getNbtCompound().getString("CustomName"));
}
```

**Returns** [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) — new copy of the block entity's data, with its ID and position; changes to it apply only through [`setNbtCompound`](#setnbtcompound)

:::

### setNbtCompound {#setnbtcompound}

::: member

Loads data into the block entity and marks it changed. Keys missing from the data may be reset by the block entity; start from [`getNbtCompound()`](#getnbtcompound) to keep them. Players may see the change only after the chunk reloads.

```js
var block = c.getWorld().getBlockEntity(2, 64, 2);
var data = block.getNbtCompound();

data.putString("CustomName", '"Treasure"');
block.setNbtCompound(data);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nbtCompound` | [`ScriptNbtCompound`](/scripting/common/nbt/ScriptNbtCompound) | data to load, not null |

:::

### getId {#getid}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — block entity type ID, like `"minecraft:chest"`

:::

### isRemoved {#isremoved}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the block entity was removed from the world, e.g. when its block was broken

:::
